verdict.rationale: Motion explicitly advertises embeddable booking links tied to live calendar availability so prospects can book instantly without back-and-forth (motion-docs-5, motion-docs-27), backed by supporting features like calendar consolidation and daily limits (motion-docs-8, motion-docs-6). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the booking-link UX and details like customizable slugs, multiple event types, or invitee confirmation flow.
